title: Touch-size sidebar rows and list actions
summary: Sidebar rows grow from 36px to 44px on touch screens (`pointer: coarse`, e.g. iPad) and stay 36px with a mouse. ListGroup header actions (“Refresh”, “See all”) get the `hit-area` utility.

requires.why: ListGroup actions use the `hit-area` utility that tokens.hit-area adds

migration: No API change. Sidebar height on touch devices increases by 8px per row.

compare.title: Grouped list with a header action (Refresh)
compare.note: Sidebar rows change only on touch screens (pointer: coarse), so the desktop preview shows no difference there.
